text: Handle zero points and exact ties
Resolve special cases explicitly in the online design.

Passing every mandatory limit does not guarantee any bonus points. The historical workshop description does not state how to compute price-per-point for a zero-point platform. The proposed rule shows no ratio in that case. Only submitted, compliant designs with positive points remain eligible for award. It uses unrounded values when comparing candidate offers.

items: For identical ratios, the proposal compares price, then total rated points, and finally allows a shared result if nothing differs. This is a modern rule choice, not a recovered workshop instruction.

text: Show missing submissions, failed limits and zero-rated offers as separate outcomes.
Display rounding must not create a tie or hide a mandatory failure.
